messages.subject: becoming a mentor
parts:
I need instructions on how to become a mentor a GSOC mentor under the R project.  I have previous GSOC experience (2 summers) and CRAN experience (maintainer for 12 CRAN packages) and domain knowledge.  The system has probably changed since I last signed up as a mentor (2016) and I don't remember what it was anyway.

--
Charles Geyer
Professor, School of Statistics
Resident Fellow, Minnesota Center for Philosophy of Science
University of Minnesota
cha...@stat.umn.edu

messages.subject: Re: becoming a mentor
parts:
Prof. Geyer,

Good to hear from you, and we're happy to have you back.

As in prior years, the basic model is the same, please put an idea page
up here:
https://github.com/rstats-gsoc/gsoc2019/wiki

With the information that your potential students would need to
complete their applications.

As always, feel free to reach out if you have questions.

Regards,

Brian
